caption: This shio ramen boasts a clear, savory broth with perfectly halved soft-boiled eggs, tender chashu, and crisp nori, artfully arranged in a white bowl with black Greek-key trim. Warm, ambient lighting highlights the dish against a wooden table.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly glossy surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, crinkled, and irregularly shaped with a slightly glossy, textured surface.
The shio (salt) broth is golden-yellow, clear, and glossy, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
A halved boiled egg shows a runny orange yolk surrounded by a firm white, with a slightly textured surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with black Greek key pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
